description: The chart on the left represents the distribution of errors made by the Vanilla model, while the chart on the right shows the distribution of errors made by the HCL model. The Vanilla model chart has four slices, with the largest slice representing 'Atomic Skill Fail' at 68.0%, followed by 'Correct' at 12.0%, 'Reason Error' at 12.0%, and the smallest slice 'Question Misunderstood' at 8.0%. The HCL model chart also has four slices, with the largest slice representing 'Correct' at 55.0%, followed by 'Reason Error' at 21.0%, 'Question Misunderstood' at 14.0%, and the smallest slice 'Atomic Skill Fail' at 10.0%. Both charts have percentage labels inside the slices, and the slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way. The slices are ordered by size, with the largest percentage at the top and the smallest at the bottom.
